_comment: RAG-1 golden corpus — tiny, synthetic, deterministic CFA/Quant/Excel curriculum chunks. Used by scripts/rag-eval.mjs and src/lib/rag/ragEval.test.ts to make retrieval quality a non-regression gate. NO real curriculum text; every chunk is hand-written to give the eval distinct lexical signals. Keep this file small.

chunks.text: Modified duration measures the percentage change in a bond price for a small parallel shift in yield, assuming cash flows do not change.
Effective duration is the appropriate duration measure for bonds with embedded options because their cash flows change when yields move.
Convexity captures the curvature of the price-yield relationship and corrects the linear estimate that duration alone provides for large yield changes.
The option-adjusted spread removes the value of embedded options from the nominal spread, isolating the compensation for credit and liquidity risk.
The dividend discount model values a share of equity as the present value of its expected future dividends discounted at the required return on equity.
Free cash flow to equity is the cash available to common shareholders after operating expenses, reinvestment, and net debt repayment, and it drives the FCFE valuation model.
Price-to-earnings and enterprise-value-to-EBITDA are relative valuation multiples used to compare a company against peers rather than against an intrinsic value estimate.
A confidence interval gives a range of plausible values for a population parameter at a stated confidence level, widening as the desired confidence increases.
The standard error of the sample mean equals the population standard deviation divided by the square root of the sample size, so larger samples give more precise estimates.
Hypothesis testing compares a test statistic against a critical value to decide whether to reject the null hypothesis at a chosen significance level.
Bayesian inference updates a prior probability into a posterior probability by weighting it with the likelihood of the observed evidence.
XLOOKUP searches a lookup array and returns a matching value from a result array, supporting both vertical and horizontal lookups and an explicit if-not-found argument.
INDEX MATCH combines two functions to perform a flexible two-way lookup that, unlike VLOOKUP, can return a value to the left of the lookup column.
A PivotTable summarises and aggregates large ranges of data by dragging fields into rows, columns, values, and filters without writing any formulas.

LOS 9.a Describe how a forward rate agreement settles. A forward rate agreement settles in cash at expiration based on the difference between the contracted forward rate and the realized reference rate, discounted back over the FRA period.
the realized reference rate, discounted back. Separately, margin requirements for futures are posted daily through mark-to-market, which is a distinct mechanism from FRA cash settlement.

My personal note on swap valuation: the value of a plain-vanilla interest-rate swap at initiation is zero, and thereafter equals the difference between the present values of the fixed and floating legs.
